	describe("Promise:cancel", function()

				v_u_1.all(v_u_1.new(function() end))
			end
			local v232, v233 = pcall(v231)
			expect(v232).to.be.ok()
			expect(v233:find("Non%-promise")).to.be.ok()
		end)
		it("should cancel pending promises if one rejects", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v234 = v_u_1.new(function() end)

			expect(v234:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)

			local v235 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			v235:andThen(function() end)

			expect(v236[2]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v236[3]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.fold", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
		it("should return the initial value in a promise when the list is empty", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v237 = {}

				error("should not be called")
			end, v237)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v238)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v238:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v238:expect()).to.equal(v237)
		end)
		it("should accept promises in the list", function()

			local v243 = v_u_1.fold({ v_u_1.new(function(p240)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_239
					v_u_239 = p240

				return p241 + p242
			end, 0)
			v_u_239(1)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v243)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v243:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v243:expect()).to.equal(6)
		end)
		it("should always return a promise even if the list or reducer don\'t use them", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
			local v247 = v_u_1.fold({ 1, 2, 3 }, function(p244, p245, p246)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				if p246 == 2 then
					return v_u_1.delay(1):andThenReturn(p244 + p245)
				else
					return p244 + p245
				end
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v247)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v247:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_6(2)
			expect(v247:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v247:expect()).to.equal(6)
		end)
		it("should return the first rejected promise", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v251 = v_u_1.fold({ 1, 2, 3 }, function(p248, p249, p250)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				if p250 == 2 then
					return v_u_1.reject("foo")
				else
					return p248 + p249
				end
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v251)).to.equal(true)
			local v252, v253 = v251:awaitStatus()
			expect(v252).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v253).to.equal("foo")
		end)
		it("should return the first canceled promise", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_254 = nil

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_254, (ref) v_u_1
				if p257 == 1 then
					return p255 + p256
				end
				if p257 == 2 then
					v_u_254 = v_u_1.delay(1):andThenReturn(p255 + p256)

				end
				error("this should not run if the promise is cancelled")
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v258)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v258:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)

	end)

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_307

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			local v311 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			local v313 = v_u_1.new(function(p312)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_310
				v_u_310 = p312
			end)

			expect(v314:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v311:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)

			expect(v314:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)

	describe("Promise.each", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should iterate", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			}, function(...)

			end):_unwrap()
			expect(v342).to.equal(true)

		it("should iterate serially", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_344 = {}
			local v_u_345 = {}
			local v351 = v_u_1.each({ "foo", "bar", "baz" }, function(p_u_346, p347)

function v_u_15.convertLabelToNumberSpinner(p_u_299, p_u_300, p_u_301) -- name: convertLabelToNumberSpinner
	task.defer(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_299, (copy) p_u_300, (copy) p_u_301
		local v_u_302 = p_u_299:getInstance("IconLabel")
		v_u_302.Transparency = 1
		p_u_300.Parent = v_u_302.Parent
		p_u_300.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		p_u_300.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		p_u_300.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		p_u_300.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		p_u_300.ClipsDescendants = false
		for _, v_u_303 in ipairs({
			"FontFace",
			"BorderSizePixel",
			"BorderColor3",
			"Rotation",
			"TextStrokeTransparency",
			"TextStrokeColor3",
			"TextStrokeTransparency",
			"TextColor3"
		}) do
			p_u_300[v_u_303] = v_u_302[v_u_303]
			p_u_299:addToJanitor(v_u_302:GetPropertyChangedSignal(v_u_303):Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_300, (copy) v_u_303, (copy) v_u_302
				p_u_300[v_u_303] = v_u_302[v_u_303]
			end))
		end
		local function v_u_308() -- name: getSpinnerSizeAndDigitCount
			-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_300
			local v304 = 0
			local v305 = 0
			for _, v306 in p_u_300.Frame:GetChildren() do
				local v307 = string.lower(v306.Name)
				if v307 == "digit" then
					v304 = v304 + v306.AbsoluteSize.X
					v305 = v305 + 1
				else
					if v307 ~= "prefix" and (v307 ~= "suffix" and v307 ~= "comma") or v306.Text == "" then
						continue
					end
					v304 = v304 + v306.AbsoluteSize.X
					v305 = v305 + 1
				end
			end
			return v304, v305
		end
		local function v_u_317() -- name: adjustSize
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_308, (ref) p_u_299, (ref) p_u_300, (copy) v_u_302
			local v309, v310 = v_u_308()
			if v310 < 18 then
				p_u_299:setLabel(p_u_300.Value)
			end
			local v311 = p_u_300.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X
			while v309 < v311 and p_u_299.isDestroyed ~= true do
				task.wait(0.05)
				if v310 > 0 and v310 < 8 then
					p_u_300.TextSize = v_u_302.TextSize
					break
				end
				local v312 = p_u_300
				v312.TextSize = v312.TextSize + 1
				v311 = p_u_300.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X
				v309, v310 = v_u_308()
			end
			local v313 = v_u_302.Parent
			if v313 then
				v313 = v313.Parent
			end
			local v314

				return
			elseif v136:FindFirstChild("CustomChar") and v136.CustomChar:GetAttribute("CustomSpecial") then
				p135:GetToolService("CustomService").Special:Fire(v_u_29.Custom())
				return
			else
				local v139 = v136:GetAttribute("Moveset")
				if v139 == "Todo" then
					p135:UseSetService("RightActivated", p135:GetTargetOrProjectile())
					return
				elseif v139 == "Naoya" or v139 == "Hanami" then
					p135:UseSetService("RightActivated", p135:GetMouseTarget(75), p135:GetTarget())
					return
				elseif v139 == "MeiMei" then
					p135:UseSetService("RightActivated", require(v_u_6.PlayerScripts.PlayerModule.ControlModule):GetMoveVector())
				else
					p135:UseSetService("RightActivated", p135:GetTarget())
				end
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v_u_24.ReleaseSpecial(p140) -- name: ReleaseSpecial
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6
	if v_u_6.Character then
		p140:UseSetService("RightDeactivated")
	end
end
function v_u_24.Block(p141) -- name: Block
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_16
	local v142 = v_u_6.Character
	if v142 then
		if v142.Info:FindFirstChild("Emote") then
			if _G.UsingPiano == 2 then
				return
			end
			v_u_18.EmoteEnd:Fire()
		end
		local v143 = p141:GetTarget()
		v_u_16.Activated:Fire(v143)
	end
end

	local function v_u_263(p250) -- name: getColorSequenceFromStr
		local v251 = {}
		for _, v252 in string.split(p250, " ") do
			local v253 = string.split(v252, ",")
			local v254 = v253[1]
			local v255 = tonumber(v254)
			local v256 = v253[2]
			local v257 = tonumber(v256)
			local v258 = v253[3]
			local v259 = tonumber(v258)
			if not (v255 and (v257 and v259)) then
				continue
			end
			v251[#v251 + 1] = Color3.fromRGB(math.clamp(v255, 0, 255), math.clamp(v257, 0, 255), (math.clamp(v259, 0, 255)))
		end
		if #v251 == 0 then
			return ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		end
		if #v251 == 1 then
			return ColorSequence.new(v251[1])
		end
		local v260 = {}
		for v261, v262 in v251 do
			v260[v261] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new((v261 - 1) / (#v251 - 1), v262)
		end
		return ColorSequence.new(v260)
	end

function v_u_14.DustBreak(_, p84, p85, p86, p87, p88, p89, p90) -- name: DustBreak
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_3
	local v91 = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
	local v92 = v91.X - p84.X
	local v93 = math.abs(v92)
	local v94 = v91.Y - p84.Y
	local v95 = v93 + math.abs(v94)
	local v96 = v91.Z - p84.Z
	if v95 + math.abs(v96) > 200 then
		return
	elseif _G.Settings.DesPHY then
		local v97 = CFrame.new(p84, p84 + p85)
		for _ = 1, p87 do
			local v98 = (v97 * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.random(0, 3.141592653589793)) * CFrame.new(math.random(0, p86 * 10) / 10, 0, 0)).Position
			local v99 = workspace:Raycast(v98, v97.LookVector * -(p90 or 8), _G.MapParams)
			if not v99 then
				continue
			end
			local v_u_100 = v_u_9.Damage.DebreeRef:Clone()
			v_u_100.Color = v99.Instance.Color
			v_u_100.Material = v99.Instance.Material
			v_u_100.Transparency = v99.Instance.Transparency
			local v101 = math.random(p88 * 10, p89 * 10) / 10
			local v102 = math.random(p88 * 10, p89 * 10) / 10
			local v103 = math.random(p88 * 10, p89 * 10) / 10
			v_u_100.Size = Vector3.new(v101, v102, v103)
			v_u_100.Position = v99.Position
			v_u_100.CollisionGroup = "Effects"
			v_u_100.Anchored = false
			local v104 = math.random(-20, 20)
			local v105 = math.random(20, 40)
			local v106 = math.random
			v_u_100.Velocity = Vector3.new(v104, v105, v106(-20, 20))
			local v107 = math.random(-200, 200)
			local v108 = math.random(-200, 200)
			local v109 = math.random
			v_u_100.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(v107, v108, v109(-200, 200))
			v_u_100.Parent = workspace.Effects
			task.delay(3, function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_100, (ref) v_u_3
				v_u_4:Create(v_u_100, TweenInfo.new(1), {
					["Transparency"] = 1
				}):Play()
				v_u_3:AddItem(v_u_100, 1)
			end)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_14.DustTrail(_, p110, p111, p_u_112) -- name: DustTrail
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_2
	local v113 = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
	local v114 = p110.PrimaryPart.Position
	local v115 = v113.X - v114.X
	local v116 = math.abs(v115)
	local v117 = v113.Y - v114.Y
	local v118 = v116 + math.abs(v117)
	local v119 = v113.Z - v114.Z
	if v118 + math.abs(v119) <= 200 then
		local v_u_120 = p110.HumanoidRootPart
		if v_u_120 then
			local v_u_121 = v_u_9.Misc.SmokeTrail:Clone()
			v_u_121.Parent = workspace.Effects
			v_u_121.CFrame = v_u_120.CFrame * (p_u_112 or CFrame.new())
			v_u_3:AddItem(v_u_121, p111 + 0.6)
			if p_u_112 then
				v_u_121.Dash.Smoke.Enabled = true
				v_u_4:Create(v_u_121.Dash.Smoke, TweenInfo.new(p111), {
					["Rate"] = 0
				}):Play()
				local v122 = workspace
				local v123 = v_u_120.Position
				local v124 = -v_u_120.Size.Y * 1.6
				local v125 = v122:Raycast(v123, Vector3.new(0, v124, 0), _G.MapParams)
				if v125 then
					v_u_121.Position = v125.Position
					v_u_121.Dash.Smoke:Emit(15)
				end
			end
			local v_u_126 = nil
			local v_u_131 = v_u_2.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_121, (copy) v_u_120, (copy) p_u_112, (ref) v_u_126
				if v_u_121 and v_u_121.Parent then
					local v127 = workspace
					local v128 = v_u_120.Position
					local v129 = -v_u_120.Size.Y * 1.6
					local v130 = v127:Raycast(v128, Vector3.new(0, v129, 0), _G.MapParams)
					if v130 then
						if p_u_112 then
							v_u_121.Dash.Smoke.Enabled = true
						end
						v_u_121.CFrame = v_u_120.CFrame * (p_u_112 or CFrame.new()) - v_u_120.Position + v130.Position
						v_u_121.Velocity = v_u_120.Velocity
						if not v_u_126 then
							v_u_126 = v_u_121.Smoke
							v_u_126.Color = ColorSequence.new(v130.Instance.Color)
							v_u_126.Enabled = true
							return
						end
						if v_u_126.Color.Keypoints[1].Value ~= v130.Instance.Color then
							v_u_126.Enabled = false
							v_u_126 = v_u_126:Clone()
							v_u_126.Color = ColorSequence.new(v130.Instance.Color)
							v_u_126.Enabled = true
							v_u_126.Parent = v_u_121
							return
						end
					else
						v_u_121.Dash.Smoke.Enabled = false
						if v_u_126 then
							v_u_126.Enabled = false
						end
					end
				end
			end)
			task.delay(p111, function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_131, (copy) v_u_121, (ref) v_u_126
				v_u_131:Disconnect()
				if v_u_121 and v_u_121.Parent then
					if v_u_126 then
						v_u_126.Enabled = false
					end
					v_u_121.Dash.Smoke.Enabled = false
				end
			end)
			return v_u_121
		end
	end
end
function v_u_14.Bleed(_, p_u_132) -- name: Bleed
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_11
	if _G.Settings.Gore == true then
		for _, v133 in v_u_9.Damage.Explode:GetDescendants() do
			if not v133:IsA("Attachment") then
				continue
			end
			v133:Clone().Parent = p_u_132:FindFirstChild(v133.Parent.Name)
		end
		if not p_u_132:GetAttribute("Bleeding") then
			p_u_132:SetAttribute("Bleeding", true)
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11, (copy) p_u_132
				repeat
					v_u_11:Blood(p_u_132.Torso.CFrame, 50, 180, 180)
					task.wait(0.1)
				until not p_u_132.Parent
			end)
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

		end
	end

function v_u_14.ApplyCopyOutfit(_, p143, p144) -- name: ApplyCopyOutfit
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9
	p144:ScaleTo(p143:GetScale())
	local v145 = {
		"Head",
		"Left Arm",
		"Left Leg",
		"Right Arm",
		"Right Leg",
		"Torso"
	}
	for _, v146 in p143:GetChildren() do
		if v146:IsA("Shirt") or (v146:IsA("TShirt") or (v146:IsA("Pants") or v146:IsA("BodyColors"))) then
			v146:Clone().Parent = p144
		elseif v146:IsA("Accessory") then
			local v147 = v146:Clone()
			v147.Parent = p144
			local v148 = v147:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld", true)
			v148.Part1 = p144:FindFirstChild(v148.Part1.Name)
		else
			if not v146:IsA("CharacterMesh") then
				continue
			end
			v146:Clone().Parent = p144
		end
	end
	if p143.Head:FindFirstChild("Mesh") then
		p144.Head.Mesh:Destroy()
		p143.Head.Mesh:Clone().Parent = p144.Head
	end
	p144:ScaleTo(1)
	local v149 = p143.Head:FindFirstChild("face")
	if v149 then
		p144.Head.face.Texture = v149.Texture
	end
	if p143:FindFirstChild("Outfit") then
		local v150 = v_u_9.Megumi.Mahoraga.Mahoraga.Outfit:Clone()
		v150.Head.Beard:Destroy()
		v150.Head.Hat:Destroy()
		v150:ScaleTo(0.6666666666666666)
		for _, v151 in v150:GetDescendants() do
			if not (v151:IsA("Weld") or v151:IsA("Motor6D")) then
				continue
			end
			if table.find(v145, v151.Part0.Name) then
				v151.Part0 = p144:FindFirstChild(v151.Part0.Name)
			end
			if not table.find(v145, v151.Part1.Name) then
				continue
			end
			v151.Part1 = p144:FindFirstChild(v151.Part1.Name)
		end
		v150.Parent = p144
	end
	if p144["Left Arm"]:FindFirstChild("FingersL") then
		for _, v152 in p144["Left Arm"].FingersL:GetChildren() do
			if not v152:IsA("BasePart") then
				continue
			end
			v152.Color = p143["Left Arm"].Color
		end
		for _, v153 in p144["Right Arm"].FingersR:GetChildren() do
			if not v153:IsA("BasePart") then
				continue
			end
			v153.Color = p143["Right Arm"].Color
		end
	end
end
function v_u_14.WorldModelChar(_, p_u_154, p_u_155) -- name: WorldModelChar

	local v156 = p_u_154:Clone()

	end
	v_u_157.PrimaryPart = v_u_157.Humanoid.RootPart

	v156:Destroy()
	v_u_157.Parent = p_u_155
	for _, v160 in v_u_157:GetChildren() do

			continue
		end
		v160.Anchored = true
	end
	local v_u_161 = nil
	v_u_161 = v_u_2.Stepped:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_154, (copy) p_u_155, (ref) v_u_161, (copy) v_u_157

			for _, v162 in v_u_157:GetChildren() do
				if not v162:IsA("BasePart") then
					continue
				end
				local v163 = p_u_154:FindFirstChild(v162.Name)
				if not v163 then
					continue
				end
				v162.CFrame = v163.CFrame
			end
		else
			v_u_161:Disconnect()
			v_u_157:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	return v_u_157
end
